content.text: if I'm not mistaken, this isn't new to 3.4. We did add/correct a number of the default namespaces in the responses for 3.4 but it looks like this one slipped through. Pretty straightforward to fix, but I want to bring it up w/ at least the other committers if not the dev list to get a sense of the impact since folks will have to update client code if it's namespace/schema-aware.
adding java-client component since fedora-client will need to be updated as well
This is now fixed in master but the updated getNextPIDInfo.xsd needs to replace the current copy on the website.

Need to highlight this in the release notes for 3.5 as it is both a schema change and a change in the response (rather than just for instance correcting the response to bring it in line with the schema).
TestAPIMLite appears to be failing on this

fcrepo-server/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/server/management/GetNextPIDServlet.java produces invalid XML - missing a quote at the end of xsi:schemaLocation.  Causing TestAPIMLite and TestAuthentication failures.
Fix committed, plus fixes for tests (needed namespaces adding to xpath stuff)
I replaced the copy on the website with the one in master. Anything left on this, besides documenting it in the release notes?

renderedFields.description:
I was updating my REST API code for the default namespaces in Fedora 3.4 and discovered that the result from getNextPid does not have the default namespace that I expected it would. It looks like this is being generated incorrectly.

Here's a sample result:

<pidList xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://myfedora.server.edu:8080/getNextPIDInfo.xsd">
<pid>changeme:226</pid>
</pidList>
